title: Lightly Glazed French Millet Madeleine
description: A funky, aerated French dish featuring millet, glaze, and high protein, served in a scallop shell, perfect for a dessert or snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the millet flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract.
Add the melted butter to the egg mixture and whisk until combined.
Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the batter into a madeleine pan or scallop shells.
Bake for 12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Allow the madeleines to cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
To make the glaze, whisk together the confectioners sugar and honey until smooth.
Drizzle the glaze over the cooled madeleines.
